presentation.fr: Petit livre d'introduction écrit en quelques semaines, resté le plus lu de ses ouvrages non techniques. Russell y expose la distinction entre <c id='knowledge-by-acquaintance'>connaissance par accointance</c> et savoir par description, le <pb>problème de l'induction</pb>, la vérité comme correspondance et le <c id='realism-of-universals'>réalisme des universaux</c>.
presentation.en: A short introductory book written in a few weeks, and still the most widely read of his non-technical works. Russell sets out the distinction between <c id='knowledge-by-acquaintance'>knowledge by acquaintance</c> and knowledge by description, the <pb>problem of induction</pb>, truth as correspondence and <c id='realism-of-universals'>realism about universals</c>.
